name: AlreadyInitialized
description: The contract has already been initialized.
user_message: This contract is already set up.

name: NotInitialized
description: The contract has not been initialized yet.
user_message: This contract is not set up yet. Please try again later.

name: FolderNameTaken
description: The Folder name is already owned by another address.
user_message: That Folder name is already taken.

name: FolderNotFound
description: No Folder exists for the given name or owner.
user_message: We could not find that Folder.

name: PortfolioNotFound
description: The owner has no minted portfolio.
user_message: No portfolio has been minted for this Folder yet.

name: TemplateNotFound
description: The template ID is not registered.
user_message: That template does not exist.

name: Unauthorized
description: The caller is not allowed to perform this action.
user_message: You are not allowed to do that.

name: InvalidCID
description: The IPFS CID is malformed.
user_message: The portfolio content ID is not valid.

name: InvalidFolderName
description: The Folder name does not follow the naming rules.
user_message: Folder names must look like name.folder and use only a-z, 0-9 and hyphens.

name: AdminAlreadyExists
description: The address is already an admin.
user_message: That address is already an admin.

name: AdminNotFound
description: The address is not an admin.
user_message: That address is not an admin.

name: CannotRemoveLastAdmin
description: Removing the admin would leave the contract without admins.
user_message: The last admin cannot be removed.

name: PortfolioAlreadyMinted
description: The owner has already minted a portfolio.
user_message: A portfolio has already been minted for this Folder.

name: InvalidMetadataURI
description: The template metadata URI is malformed.
user_message: The template metadata link is not valid.

name: TemplateAlreadyExists
description: The template ID is already registered.
user_message: A template with that ID already exists.

name: FolderAlreadyClaimed
description: The owner already holds a Folder.
user_message: You already own a Folder.

name: InvalidTemplateID
description: The template ID is out of range.
user_message: That template ID is not valid.

name: TemplateLimitReached
description: The maximum number of templates is registered.
user_message: No more templates can be registered.

name: TooManyAdmins
description: The maximum number of admins is reached.
user_message: No more admins can be added.

name: InvalidAmount
description: The token amount is negative, zero where not allowed, or above its cap.
user_message: The amount is not valid.

name: InsufficientBalance
description: The contract treasury holds less than the requested amount.
user_message: The treasury does not hold enough funds for this withdrawal.
